title: Go out of office in one click
intro: We will press one button and watch four chores get done before you leave the office.

steps.say: This chat is made up, and nothing is sent. You are leaving on Friday.
act: You are leaving on Friday. One button does the four things you would normally do by hand.
Hand off open items to your backup

steps.say: You press one button, and four chores are ticked off.
act: I am going out of office

steps.say: You can leave without losing any productivity.
act: Done (demo). Peace of mind to leave the office, without losing any productivity.
